slices.focus: Nadia uses wedding savings to cover Leila's unexpected college housing charge, forcing another reception scale-down.
slices.summary: Leila's summer aid package falls short and an unexpected housing charge forces Nadia to pull from the wedding envelope hidden in a boot box. She tells Omar the same night. They face a second round of reception downsizing. Nadia plans to create three labeled budget buckets (wedding, emergency, family support), set a clearer limit with Leila, and have one quiet hour at aunt Maha's kitchen table to realign finances with Omar.
open_loops: Hold one quiet budget hour to create three labeled buckets (wedding, emergency, family support)
Set a clear limit for family support with structure vs. open-ended help
Discuss reception cuts with Omar using real numbers
Separate symbolic wedding money from true emergency buffer
